objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Make the file content fetch scenario load a resource it was never meant to, and read /ctf/flag from the server's own disk.
hints: The file content fetch page expects a file name, but the PHP function behind it accepts URLs too.
A URL is not limited to http: one scheme points at the server's local files.

steps.title: Find the page
steps.prompt: Which PHP page of the file content fetch scenario loads the resource you name? (its file name)

steps.title: Find the input
steps.prompt: Which POST parameter carries the resource to load?

steps.title: Find the sink
steps.prompt: Which PHP function fetches it, local file or URL alike?

steps.title: Point at a local file
steps.prompt: Which URI scheme names a file on the server's own disk?
